about: Every analysis run in this project, newest last. tools/gold_tracker.py renders it into build/pdfref/GOLD_TRACKER.{html,md}. Append an entry for each new analysis.

entries.analysis: Ported the 2026 document's configuration rules (Kshin Moon, Total Days, Rahu/Ketu nakshatra on Thursday, Moon-Mercury D9, eclipses, Moon rashi parivartan, month systems, B19/B111/B116/B117, benefic/malefic valence).
entries.result: Rules print in the 2026 table layout; base layer for every later analysis.

entries.analysis: Read Tech Astro Analysis (2020) and KD 2026 in full; added every computable rule; built a New York (ET) 2027 calendar with 9 fields per event; extracted both PDFs to HTML.
entries.result: ~730 rules in the catalogue; ~1,600 major events in the 2027 NY calendar; validation 51/58 against the 2026 printed rows.

entries.analysis: Every rule that names gold / silver, 20 Nov 2026 - 31 Dec 2027, US Eastern time, each boundary checked against the astronomy layer.
entries.result: Gold report ~205 rows, silver report 117 rows.

entries.analysis: Added the user's Sun rules: Sun in Venus/Mercury/Jupiter nakshatra (U1, rise); Venus, Mercury, Jupiter or waxing Moon with/aspecting the Sun (U2, hike); Sun in Saturn/Rahu nakshatra (U3, fall); Saturn or Rahu with/aspecting the Sun (U4, crash).
entries.result: U1-U4 in the gold report with a Sun-state timeline; conflicts with TA S34 noted on each row.

entries.analysis: Checked every silver bull/bear item in the PDFs and resources against the report.
entries.result: Added Rahu in Dhanishta (bullion risk) and Venus retrograde in Taurus; Moon-based mirror of U1-U4 NOT implemented (no source backing).

entries.analysis: Full 2026 comparison of the gold section; Indian gold-demand dates (Kindle Ch15); Abhijit span fix.
entries.result: Gold coverage complete for computable rules.

entries.analysis: Every gold rule scored against COMEX gold (GC=F) daily closes, 20 Nov 2025 - 20 Nov 2026; failure causes, biggest moves.
entries.result: 61 of 124 decided occurrences worked (49%); bearish-majority days were followed by -1.49% over 5 days; the Jan-2026 crash was not flagged by any rule.

entries.analysis: Same rule set, 20 Nov 2021 - 20 Nov 2026, with per-year drift-aware base rates, binomial p-values and per-year results.
entries.result: 288 of 554 worked (52%) vs 54% by chance; best: combined Sun model 105/179 (p=0.057), U2-Jupiter, U2-Venus, U2-Mercury right in 4 of 5 years; U4-Saturn did not hold up (6/20).

entries.analysis: Rule-status table combining the 1- and 5-year backtests; dates of the best-performing rules from 20 Nov 2026 to 31 Dec 2027; this log.
